items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Every FR-01.09 AC appended for this change (release page created, condensed-but-checked, link back, best-effort/forward-only) is implemented and covered by a test; no extra feature was added beyond what the iterate spec and mini-plan scope (no backfill, no config surface beyond what SKILL.md documents).

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Every stage (extract/condense/repo-identity/validate/create) reports a distinct, never-swallowed status instead of raising; the orchestrator wraps every branch in an explicit if, so a mid-chain failure always reaches the final JSON. gh and OpenAI calls are wrapped (OSError/TimeoutExpired/generic exception) and reported, never left to crash the phase.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No SQL/HTML injection surface (no DB, no served HTML). Version strings are validated against a strict regex before reaching gh's argv (leading-dash-as-flag injection closed, tested). API keys are read from env vars only, never hardcoded. The condensation call is tool-less by construction (tested) so prompt-injected CHANGELOG content cannot escalate to an action. validate_release_notes.py is a deterministic gate the LLM output must pass before publishing, and the caller publishes exactly its sanitized_body, never the raw completion.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Every module has both a happy-path and an error/edge-path test (see the Test Completeness Ledger, 54 tested rows); tests assert on returned status/content, not internal state. gh/OpenAI/git-remote calls are mocked or run against real local git fixtures — nothing hits a real network service or a real GitHub API from a test run.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No loops of DB/network calls, no list endpoints, no async handlers — this is a single-release, single-shot CLI orchestration (extract -> condense -> validate -> create), each stage called at most once per invocation.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New tools live under shared/scripts/tools (existing convention for cross-plugin CLI helpers) and shared/scripts/lib (repo_identity, a small shared helper); tests live under shared/tests/, one file per module. Every new source and test file is under the 300-line convention (largest: validate_release_notes.py at 205, test_extract_changelog_section.py at 165). SKILL.md was trimmed to stay within its bloat-baseline current (424 of 425).

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Three producer/consumer pairs identified in the iterate spec's Affected Boundaries section. aggregator->extractor got a real round-trip test (test_aggregator_extractor_round_trip, byte-equality against the real renderer). create_github_release->GitHub API is unprobeable from CI by design (never invoke a real gh release create from a test); the standing substitute is the argv-shape assertion (test_success_argv_shape). touches_io_boundary risk flag applies and is satisfied.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: `uv run shared/scripts/tools/scan_test_hygiene.py --diff` reported no findings against the changed test files.
